assemblyloadcontext-collectible.title: Load collectible plugins with AssemblyLoadContext
assemblyloadcontext-collectible.short: Isolate an assembly load scope that can later be reclaimed
assemblyloadcontext-collectible.summary: A collectible AssemblyLoadContext loads assemblies into an isolated context that can become eligible for collection after Unload when no strong references remain.
assemblyloadcontext-collectible.why: Long-running applications can replace plugin code without permanently accumulating every loaded assembly in the default context.
assemblyloadcontext-collectible.tips: Unload is cooperative rather than immediate. References to loaded types or instances can keep the context alive; WeakReference can help verify unloading.

ratelimiter-token-bucket.title: Limit throughput with TokenBucketRateLimiter
ratelimiter-token-bucket.short: Refill permits over time to control request rate
ratelimiter-token-bucket.summary: TokenBucketRateLimiter replenishes tokens on a schedule and requires callers to acquire permits before starting limited work.
ratelimiter-token-bucket.why: It can protect an external API or expensive operation from bursts while still allowing a configured amount of short-term traffic.
ratelimiter-token-bucket.tips: Choose queue limits and replenishment settings from the real downstream limit, and define whether failed acquisitions wait, reject, or retry.

meter-counter.title: Measure operation counts with Meter and Counter
meter-counter.short: Expose application metrics to diagnostics infrastructure
meter-counter.summary: System.Diagnostics.Metrics Meter creates instruments such as Counter that publish request counts and other measurements to metric listeners.
meter-counter.why: Important operational numbers can be modeled directly as metrics instead of reconstructed by counting log messages.
meter-counter.tips: Reuse Meter instances and avoid tags with unbounded cardinality such as user IDs.

process-argumentlist.title: Pass process arguments with ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList
process-argumentlist.short: Avoid hand-building a quoted command-line string
process-argumentlist.summary: ArgumentList accepts each child-process argument separately so platform-specific quoting and escaping do not have to be manually concatenated into one string.
process-argumentlist.why: Hand-built argument strings are easy to get wrong for paths with spaces and especially risky when values contain external input.
process-argumentlist.tips: Do not use ArgumentList and Arguments together, and do not let untrusted input choose the executable itself without validation.

appcontext-basedirectory.title: Build application-relative paths from AppContext.BaseDirectory
appcontext-basedirectory.short: Avoid depending on the current working directory
appcontext-basedirectory.summary: AppContext.BaseDirectory exposes the application's base directory and can anchor paths to files shipped alongside the application.
appcontext-basedirectory.why: A relative path based only on the current working directory can point somewhere different depending on how the program was launched.
appcontext-basedirectory.tips: The application directory is not always an appropriate writable data location; use OS-specific data directories when the purpose requires them.

ipaddress-tryparse.title: Parse IP addresses with IPAddress.TryParse
ipaddress-tryparse.short: Validate IPv4 or IPv6 text without exceptions for normal failure
ipaddress-tryparse.summary: IPAddress.TryParse converts supported textual IP address forms into IPAddress and reports invalid input with false.
ipaddress-tryparse.why: Downstream network logic can receive a parsed address type instead of repeatedly treating an address as an arbitrary string.
ipaddress-tryparse.tips: Successful parsing does not make an address safe to contact. Validate loopback, private, or other ranges separately when the use case requires it.

runtimefeature-dynamic-code.title: Check dynamic-code support with RuntimeFeature
runtimefeature-dynamic-code.short: Select an AOT-friendly implementation when runtime code generation is unavailable
runtimefeature-dynamic-code.summary: RuntimeFeature.IsDynamicCodeSupported reports whether the current runtime supports dynamic code generation.
runtimefeature-dynamic-code.why: AOT environments may not support implementation techniques such as Reflection.Emit that work in ordinary JIT deployments.
runtimefeature-dynamic-code.tips: Keep the check near an implementation boundary and prefer source generation or other AOT-friendly designs where practical.

nativelibrary-load.title: Load native libraries explicitly with NativeLibrary
nativelibrary-load.short: Pair native handle acquisition with guaranteed release
nativelibrary-load.summary: NativeLibrary.Load dynamically loads a native library and NativeLibrary.Free releases the corresponding handle.
nativelibrary-load.why: Applications that choose native functionality or plugins at runtime can manage the native library lifetime explicitly.
nativelibrary-load.tips: Do not construct library search paths from untrusted input, and guarantee Free on exception paths after a handle has been acquired.

x509certificate2-createfrompem.title: Load PEM certificates with X509Certificate2.CreateFromPem
x509certificate2-createfrompem.short: Create a certificate from PEM certificate and private-key text
x509certificate2-createfrompem.summary: CreateFromPem parses PEM-encoded certificate and private-key data and creates a corresponding X509Certificate2.
x509certificate2-createfrompem.why: It avoids custom Base64 splitting and key-format assembly when PEM material must be loaded by an application.
x509certificate2-createfrompem.tips: Do not log or casually persist private-key text, and remember that successful parsing is separate from validating certificate trust.

dns-gethostaddressesasync.title: Resolve host names with Dns.GetHostAddressesAsync
dns-gethostaddressesasync.short: Obtain IP addresses asynchronously from a host name
dns-gethostaddressesasync.summary: Dns.GetHostAddressesAsync resolves a host name and asynchronously returns the IP addresses produced by DNS resolution.
dns-gethostaddressesasync.why: Network code can perform name resolution without synchronously blocking the calling thread and can propagate cancellation.
dns-gethostaddressesasync.tips: Expect multiple addresses and changing answers over time; avoid inventing an indefinite cache that ignores DNS lifetime behavior.
